title: Democratic Impact Monitor: Police Working Conditions Welfare and Shift Reform Bill
objective: Track 8-hour shift compliance, weekly rest days, and police housing allocation.

indicators.name: Police 8-Hour Shift and Rest Day Compliance Rate
indicators.definition: Proportion of police stations complying with 8-hour shifts and granting 1 weekly rest day.

oversight.composition: Judges, labor welfare experts, retired officers, health professionals
oversight.powers: Statutory audit and housing fund allocation

triggers.condition: Systemic failure to implement 8-hour shifts or grant weekly rest days in any police district.
triggers.detector: National Police Welfare Portal & Officer Grievances
triggers.correction: Staffing reallocation and Superintendent explanation directive
